create.name: Fred von Allmen
create.bio:
Fred von Allmen is a Swiss teacher of Buddhist meditation whose own practice goes back more than fifty years. He studied with teachers of the Tibetan Dzogchen and Gelug schools and of the Theravada insight tradition, and has spent around seven years in retreat altogether. He began teaching in 1984 and for decades led retreats in many countries; these days he teaches only in Switzerland.

He co-founded the Meditationszentrum Beatenberg, a Buddhist retreat centre in the Bernese Oberland, and served on its foundation board for many years. Most of his teaching now happens there, in silent vipassana retreats lasting from a weekend to two weeks, often paired with one of the heart practices: metta (goodwill), mudita (shared joy) or karuna (compassion). He usually co-leads with fellow teachers, some of whom he authorised himself, and many retreats can also be joined by livestream. His emphasis is on seeing clearly into the workings of heart and mind, grounded in an altruistic wish to benefit others. He has written several books in German, including Mit Buddhas Augen sehen and Buddhas tausend Gesichter, and co-wrote Grundlagen des Buddhismus and Mahamudra & Vipassana. Recordings of his talks, in German and English, are on his Dharma Edu YouTube channel.

courses.title: 3 Tage Metta-Retreat (December 2026)
courses.description: A three-day residential retreat in silence at the Beatenberg centre devoted to metta, the practice of goodwill towards oneself and others. Fred von Allmen leads it with Kathleen Royston and Isis Bianzano.
courses.price: CHF 275.00 plus tourist tax and a donation to the teachers at the end

courses.title: 3 Tage Metta-Retreat - livestream (December 2026)
courses.description: The same December loving-kindness retreat followed from home by livestream, with the talks and guided sittings broadcast from Beatenberg.
courses.price: CHF 84.00 plus a donation to the teachers at the end

courses.title: 6 Tage Vipassana- und Mudita-Retreat (New Year 2026/27)
courses.description: A six-day silent retreat over the turn of the year that pairs insight meditation with mudita, the cultivation of gladness at the good fortune of others. Co-led with Ursula Flückiger and Ingeborg Mösching.
courses.price: CHF 545.00 plus tourist tax and a donation to the teachers at the end

courses.title: 6 Tage Vipassana- und Mudita-Retreat - livestream (New Year 2026/27)
courses.description: The New Year insight and mudita retreat joined online, following the daily programme of sittings and teachings from the centre.
courses.price: CHF 168.00 plus a donation to the teachers at the end

courses.title: 9 Tage Vipassana-Retreat (mit Metta)
courses.description: A nine-day spring retreat in silence combining insight practice with loving-kindness, co-led with Isis Bianzano and Kathrin Weyermann. Shorter four- and five-day livestream options are also offered.
courses.price: From CHF 836.00 plus tourist tax and a donation to the teachers at the end

courses.title: 9 Tage Vipassana-Retreat (mit Metta) - Livestream
courses.description: The full nine-day spring retreat followed online from home, with the same schedule of guided sittings and evening talks.
courses.price: CHF 270.00 plus a donation to the teachers at the end

courses.title: 14 Day Vipassana and Metta Retreat
courses.description: A two-week summer retreat taught in English, a week of loving-kindness followed by a week of insight practice, which can also be booked one week at a time. He teaches it with Ursula Flückiger, Carol Wilson and Doris Eckstein.
courses.price: From CHF 1,296.00 plus tourist tax and a donation to the teachers at the end

courses.title: 3 Tage Metta-Retreat (December 2027)
courses.description: A short winter retreat on goodwill and kindness, held in silence at Beatenberg with Ingeborg Mösching and Kathleen Royston; a livestream place is also available.
courses.price: From CHF 284.00 plus tourist tax and a donation to the teachers at the end

courses.title: 6 Tage Vipassana-Retreat (mit Karuna/Mitgefühl)
courses.description: A six-day New Year retreat joining insight meditation with karuna, the training in compassion, co-led with Ursula Flückiger and Rainer Künzi. It can also be followed by livestream.
courses.price: From CHF 560.00 plus tourist tax and a donation to the teachers at the end

Own site fredvonallmen.ch (linked from his karuna.ch teacher entry) loads its content through JavaScript from an internal data feed, so its pages read as an empty shell; nothing was taken from it beyond the YouTube link in its menu. Internal API not used.

Base: Beatenberg is the centre he co-founded and teaches at (karuna.ch/lehrende says he now teaches only in Switzerland); his home town is not published. Beatenberg is a village of about 1,200 people; please map it (nearest towns Interlaken / Thun).
Regional: Bernese Oberland, Switzerland; Spiritpedia has few or no teachers there.

Photo: only one, from his karuna.ch teacher entry; it is 232 x 308 px (just over 300 px tall, under 300 px wide). Clearly the same older man named in the entry; YouTube avatar is a letter placeholder, not used.

Resident/co-founder rule: each of his own retreats at the centre he co-founded counts as an item (nine dated retreats, all starting after 9 Nov 2026). Two December 2026 retreats were shown as 'Warteliste' (waiting list) on 5 Nov 2026.
Retreat titles kept in German as published (one summer retreat is taught in English). Prices from karuna.ch/kurse; those shown 'Ab' are listed as 'From'.
Video durations were not shown on the channel page; all are dharma talks by him from his own channel and passed oEmbed. Titles are in German apart from one English talk.
A web search result showed him on the Insight Meditation Society teacher pages (dharma.org); not opened and not added as a hub because his own site could not be read for a current IMS programme.
Born 1943 (his channel has an 80th-birthday video from 2023; a search snippet from SRF gives the year); still teaching (retreats scheduled to 2027).
